PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a credible developer-tool beta with strong MyGRACE integrity, honest install documentation, local release smoke coverage, and release checksum verification.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards
EVIDENCE.CI_GATE: Full scripts/ci.sh gate passes, including fmt, clippy, runtime guard, tests, release smoke, verify, review, refresh, and status
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_SMOKE: Local release smoke builds locked release binary, packages Linux x86_64 tarball, verifies SHA256SUMS, extracts, and runs syn --version
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: Installer uses safe temporary directories, supports SYN_INSTALL_DIR, verifies SHA256SUMS, and falls back to cargo source install when no prebuilt artifact exists

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_PLATFORM_MATRIX: Only Linux x86_64 is currently published as a prebuilt release artifact
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_REAL_RELEASE_DOWNLOAD: Smoke validates locally packaged artifacts, not a live GitHub release download
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_NON_DEVELOPER_INSTALL: Source fallback still requires Rust and git, which is acceptable for developers but weak for non-developers
